scope: Conservative Python subprocess/dynamic-import findings; classifications do not authorize scientific-provider traffic.

dispositions.rationale: The helper is called only with local git merge-base and git diff commands.
Call sites are local git status/rev-list/diff/ls-files or repository-local Python validation/export scripts; no provider transport is invoked.
The dynamic argv launches the repository-local deterministic rebuild builder with the current Python executable.
The only literal network subprocess is git fetch of a retained protocol source commit from origin; it is source-control provenance retrieval, not scientific-provider HTTP.
The helper executes local git inspection commands and repository-local Python analysis/validation commands; no live provider client is passed through this subprocess helper.
The dynamic import only verifies whether named Python packages are importable; importing is not a scientific-provider dispatch path.
